rationale: The experiment used isolated NBP reported as derived from Chinese celery seeds in MPP+-exposed PC12 cells. The measured endpoints are viability, oxidative and mitochondrial outcomes and alpha-synuclein, without stalk ingestion or visible tremor.
The abstract combines cell and rodent rotenone models. Isolated NBP reduced apomorphine-evoked rotations and changed dopaminergic markers. Drug-evoked rotations do not measure resting tremor.
The MPP+-treated PC12 cell comparison examines NBP, metabolic viability and LC3 or alpha-synuclein autophagy. The model has no behavioral or dietary outcome.

The chemistry review describes celery essential oil among sources of phthalides, also found in other plants and organisms. Its abstract reports no raw-stalk allocation or primary resting-tremor comparison.

The first Bengbu LPS mouse report uses gavaged NBP in soybean oil and reports rotarod plus open-field line crossing, rearing and grooming. The paper offers no scored rest-tremor item. This report and PMID29286148 have similar institutions, intervention and follow-up without confirmed animal-level independence.

The Bengbu LPS mouse report measures rotarod and open-field line crossing, rearing and grooming at 4 and 28 weeks. Although tremor and dyskinesia occur in the authors’ interpretation, no separately operationalized rest-tremor or levodopa-dyskinesia outcome is tabulated. Animal independence from PMID28849056 is unconfirmed.

Figure 4 separately scores resting tremor in MPTP mice receiving oral methanolic extract of whole dried Apium graveolens. The solvent extract, composite plant parts and induced animal model do not test raw stalk or a Parkinson patient outcome.

The MPTP mouse experiments compare isolated NBP on open-field activity, pole performance, hanging wire and rotarod, alongside cellular assays. No isolated resting tremor is measured. Interpret mechanism using figures corrected by PMID34295236.

The NBP trial in Parkinson uses a combined off-medication rest, action and postural tremor subtotal. Table II contains baseline means above the stated subtotal ceiling and closely repeated PDQ-39 values. No separate rest-tremor item values or verified food contrast.

The synthesis includes eight pharmaceutical adjunct trials, 638 participants, and four composite-UPDRS trials in Figure 5, including the already cataloged 2017 Wang trial. No separate rest item is pooled. The forest plot’s negative upper bound conflicts with the positive bound in prose.

The neurologic drug review discusses NBP as a celery-oil constituent. Its Parkinson section summarizes cell and rodent dopaminergic mechanisms and motor measures without an original raw-stalk or patient rest-tremor comparison.

A separate n=60 randomized Baoding Parkinson dementia cohort received donepezil alone or plus NBP capsules, oxiracetam and Ginkgo. Static tremor is an eligibility possibility. Follow-up outcomes are cognitive and dementia scales rather than an isolated tremor measure.
The intervention is a hybrid alpha-lipoic-acid–NBP molecule. Cell survival and oxidative damage in neuronal cell models do not measure food exposure, rest tremor or effects of NBP itself in patients.

The chapter discusses an author-group preclinical Parkinson and concussive injury model with nanowired NBP and mesenchymal stem cells. Tissue and fluid markers are reported without a culinary exposure or clinical tremor result.

The experiment treats rotenone-exposed microglia with NBP and measures mitochondrial potential, oxidative stress and pathway markers. The origin note concerns isolated seed compound and the measured outcomes are cellular.

The A53T Parkinson-model mice receive isolated NBP. The original behavioral methods assess rotarod coordination, anxiety-like measures, cognition and olfaction. The non-tremor-dominant human claim in its introduction cites Zhou 2019 and supplies no new human outcome.
The corrigendum replaces or reassigns images and bands in Figs. 5B, 6B and 8B of PMID30873019. It adds no cohort, motor measure or rest-tremor contrast.

The 120-patient cerebral-infarction trial compares butylphthalide with conventional care on stroke scales and biomarkers. PARK7 is an assayed protein and does not identify a Parkinson population or tremor outcome.

MPTP mouse and treated neuroblastoma models measure motor behavior, dopaminergic neuron loss and inflammasome or mitochondrial outcomes after isolated NBP. No clinical resting-tremor item or food preparation is tested.
The 120-patient acute infarction comparison measures NIH Stroke Scale and serum biomarkers including PARK7. The study is a stroke cohort and reports no raw celery or Parkinson rest-tremor result.

Rotenone-model rats receive intragastric isolated NBP. Figure 2 pairs rotarod, beam balance and foot faults with the related intervention. Resting or quiescent tremor is clinical background and is not separately measured.

The pharmacology review combines marketed butylphthalide, its derivatives and multiple disease mechanisms. The indexed abstract supplies no identified primary raw-stalk or isolated rest-tremor comparison.
The rat experiment models Huntington disease with malonic acid. Parkinson appears as prior NBP research. The reported locomotor, rotarod and cognitive outcomes pertain to the Huntington model.
The experiment assesses NBP effects on toxic-injury viability and proteomics in N2A cells, including p53 pathway markers. No animal or patient tremor, or oral celery exposure, is measured.

The NBP study compares ferroptosis-related viability and other cell markers in dopaminergic MES23.5 cells. Motor and cognitive references from other animal studies do not supply a new in vivo tremor result.

The chapter discusses its group’s Parkinson plus concussive-injury models with nanowired NBP, cells and antibodies. The abstract reports tissue neuroprotection within the same program as PMID33223034, without verified independent material or patient tremor.

The celery scoping review identifies one human Parkinson trial, Zhou 2019 PMID30988766, testing pharmaceutical DL-NBP. Documented improvements concern non-tremor subtotal, sleep and quality of life. No separate rest item or new culinary celery cohort is provided.

The chapter concerns immobilization-stress exacerbation in a Parkinson model and nanowired NBP with anti-alpha-synuclein antibodies. Its results refer to model brain pathology and a shared project series, without a human or food-related tremor measure.
The current experiment combines nanowired NBP with neprilysin in an Alzheimer model with head injury. Prior Parkinson model work appears as rationale and supplies no new Parkinson rest-tremor result.

The rotenone mouse and cell experiments test isolated NBP on neuroinflammation and assess coordination in rotarod and balance-beam tasks. No dietary celery stalk or separately measured resting tremor.

Wang’s n=126 Zhengzhou retrospective Parkinson dementia cohort compares 12-week standard care plus donepezil with or without NBP capsules. Tremor is a baseline phenotype (16/50 versus 24/76). The follow-up Figure 2A reports only composite UPDRS.

Isolated synthetic NBP is tested in rotenone-model rats. Figure 1E assesses olfaction with a buried pellet, alongside motor tasks. The pellet is a sensory test stimulus, with no raw celery or resting-tremor item.
The mouse and cell experiments evaluate systemic dopamine and NBP co-delivery by targeted liposomes, via behavioral, distribution and cell endpoints. No food exposure or human resting-tremor result.
The MPTP mouse experiment tests isolated NBP on microglia and measures open-field and pole performance. These tasks and cellular outcomes do not establish a distinct resting tremor response.

The primary new experiments concern isolated NBP and ferroptotic injury in SH-SY5Y cells. The abstract mentions earlier mouse behavioral data as prior work and reports no new behavioral or patient tremor contrast.

The review summarizes natural phthalides, highlighting multiple medicinal plants and NBP or other isolates in cell and animal Parkinson models. Its abstract supplies no food trial or item-level tremor result.

The indexed and publisher abstract label Apium clinical evidence Grade B. Public Supplement 3 identifies exactly one Apium row, pharmaceutical NBP in Zhou 2019 PMID30988766. The review repeats a composite tremor result. No independent raw celery or rest-tremor item is shown. Main article requires subscription.
This oral NBP placebo trial enrolled spinocerebellar ataxia type 3, with ataxia severity and functional index primary outcomes. It does not treat Parkinson rest tremor or test edible celery.

The 119-person Chengdu retrospective comparison adds NBP soft capsules to donepezil and levodopa/benserazide. Resting tremor appears within a grouped clinical response criterion. Figure 1 reports only total UPDRS II and III, without a distinct symptom result.
